answer: Cross-Epoch Drift Scoring. Each identity carries a private behavioural fingerprint—action timing, counterparty mix, message entropy—scored per epoch. Promotion to higher-trust tiers requires the fingerprint to bridge smoothly: drift beyond a threshold resets tier. A sudden tide of new identities with identical drift patterns is flagged as one cluster, since honest agents vary. The system only needs a whisper of correlation across epochs to link them.
